stateMapping.locations/origins/names: Volume-relative paths and recorded Trash origins; name clashes keep both entries
stateMapping.selected/folder/stale: Folder selection and the delayed storageChanged refresh that removes missing selections
stateMapping.review/revisions: Agent FilesIdentity size/modified checks in reviewed storage transfers
stateMapping.access: Current storage permission admission, rechecked by the native bridge

abstractions: Three files, three folders and three names model the current volume browser, categories, Trash and reviewed agent transfers. The previous SAF-tree listing model is superseded.
The transition structure follows design/view-refresh-2026-11/tla/files-browser with category, name-conflict and reviewed-identity fixes enabled. Grant withdrawal is additionally modeled.

Multi-volume traversal, recursive byte copying, per-item batch failures, MIME parsing and the 30-day Trash timer remain covered by their implementation tests. This model does not represent document-picker or persistent SAF-tree access.
Opaque identity revisions represent the native size/modified pair. Matching that pair is the current implementation guard, not a cryptographic assertion about file contents.

stateMapping.view/day/month/search/menu/deleteSheet/c: Calendar persistent view choice and transient Back ordering
stateMapping.generation/desiredRange/requestRange/req: single-flight desired-range loading and stale result rejection
stateMapping.owner/hidden/googleRowsOwner/localAccess: owner-scoped Google preferences and separately permitted local/source rows
stateMapping.form/formDay/creationId/durableDraft/sub: civil-date draft recovery, retained creation identity and immutable save snapshot

abstractions: Two source identities (device event and Google event), two account identities, day/month offsets -1..1 and up to five read-generation changes.
Date arithmetic, DST resolution, recurrence expansion and visual grid geometry remain pure implementation contracts; this model tracks transitions and retained identities across those calculations.
Calendar writes are modeled in CalendarSync. This module tracks presentation/read/draft state and never gives a restored form provider authority.
Cached rows may remain while a broader/narrower range is loading. Committed-result freshness and owner isolation are checked independently of cache presentation.

The removed direct Google view adapter is superseded by the canonical AgentCalendar controller and presentation adapter. The older Android/browser-local Calendar adapter remains an explicitly selected source. This model abstracts their common owner/range/form guards and does not equate their provider data models.
Hold requires a durable matching saved draft. Per-binding sending markers survive process restart and require review, while confirmed non-dispatch unmarks the original binding.
Atomic hold abstracts the serialized marking write and its current-binding check. Storage failure, ownership changes and unsettled recovery retain source regression coverage.

stateMapping.enabled/paused/access/connected/selected: independent collection, system permission, app selection, preview and history authority
stateMapping.policyRevision/epoch/readEpoch/rowEpoch/: reviewed policy updates, callback invalidation and exact displayed/action revision
stateMapping.signature/selectedSignature/sameUser/own: pinned native package certificate, user and notification UID admission
stateMapping.native/locked/rowPresent/rowText: native locked-row removal and browser locked metadata redaction
stateMapping.historyCount/historyAge/historySignature: bounded 24-hour metadata history with signature pruning, storage errors and explicit clear
stateMapping.appEnabled/channelEnabled: Alpha own-notification gates, independent of external collection

abstractions: One representative external package and notification, signatures/revisions 0..2, policy epochs 0..4, two retained metadata rows and two time buckets representing the 24-hour boundary.

Persisted history is modeled only as metadata count, age and package signature. Its schema contains no title, message body, PendingIntent or provider key. Encryption and exact byte limits remain pinned implementation contracts.
The native branch drops all locked rows; the browser branch can show a redacted app label while locked. Native package replacement requires removal before selection can pin its new signature.
External notification posts are environmental events. The browser synthetic injection UI is admitted only by DevelopmentSurfaces; this specification performs no external actions.
Query strings are finite validity classes for exact state shape, duplicates, size limits, result exclusivity and recognized keys.
Parsing, URL scrubbing and validation are ordered internal stages. The model records only link exposure and explicit handoff, without invoking an external handler.
